response: ["The guideline corpus provides recommendations for initial local management of melanoma.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also recommended for melanoma in situ.","Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.","When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.","Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.","The recommendation is consensus‑based with a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21)."]
